edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making ownership caller-defined.
transfer uses msg.sender for frozen/lock checks and balance debiting.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] for the allowance check.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender is forwarded to the untrusted spender callback receiveApproval.
increaseAllowance modifies the caller's allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance modifies the caller's allowance entry.
lock is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
unlock is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
freezeAccount is guarded by onlyOwner.
unfreezeAccount is guarded by onlyOwner.
distribute is guarded by onlyOwner.
distributeWithLockup is guarded by onlyOwner.
claimToken is guarded by onlyOwner.
burn is guarded by onlyOwner and uses msg.sender as the burner.
mint is guarded by onlyOwner.
autoUnlock compares block.timestamp against lockup releaseTime.
releaseTimeLock derives sinceFrom and sinceRound from now.
getNowTime exposes the block timestamp directly.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer checks locks[msg.sender] before moving funds.
transfer is guarded by the notFrozen modifier reading frozen.
transfer calls autoUnlock when the sender is locked.
transferFrom debits and credits balances.
transferFrom spends the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom calls autoUnlock when the source is locked.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall internally invokes approve.
approveAndCall makes an external call to the spender contract after approval.
claimToken makes an external token.transfer call.
balanceOf reads balances[_holder].
balanceOf reads lockupInfo[_holder] to sum locked balances.
balanceOf performs an unchecked addition of balances and locked balances.
lock debits balances[_holder].
lock pushes a new LockupInfo entry.
lock sets locks[_holder] to true.
unlock deletes and swaps lockupInfo entries.
unlock clears locks[_holder] when the array empties.
unlock credits balances[_holder] with the released amount.
distribute moves value from owner balance to recipient balance.
distributeWithLockup calls distribute first.
distributeWithLockup calls lock afterwards.
burn reduces balances[burner].
burn reduces totalSupply_.
mint increases totalSupply_.
mint credits balances[_to].
autoUnlock iterates lockupInfo[_holder].
autoUnlock reads locks[_holder] to decide when to stop.
autoUnlock invokes releaseTimeLock for matured entries.
releaseTimeLock mutates lockupInfo entries.
releaseTimeLock credits balances[_holder] with released tokens.
releaseTimeLock clears locks[_holder] when entries are exhausted.
showLockState reads lockupInfo[_holder][_idx].
showLockState reads locks[_holder].
constructor assigns the whole supply to balances[owner].
_to parameter feeds the transfer recipient.
_value parameter feeds the transfer amount.
_from parameter feeds the transferFrom source.
_spender parameter feeds the approve spender.
_holder parameter feeds the lock holder.
_amount parameter feeds the lock amount.
_idx parameter selects the lockup entry in unlock.
releaseAmount is computed and used inside releaseTimeLock.
lockedBalance accumulates entries inside balanceOf.
idx drives the lockupInfo loop inside autoUnlock.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient recipient parameter consumed directly by transfer.
_value is a transient amount parameter consumed directly by transfer.
_from is a transient source parameter consumed directly by transferFrom.
_spender is a transient spender parameter consumed directly by approve.
_holder is a transient owner-set holder parameter consumed directly by lock.
_amount is a transient lock amount consumed directly by lock.
_idx is a transient array index consumed directly by unlock.
releaseAmount only exists transiently within releaseTimeLock execution.
lockedBalance only exists transiently within balanceOf execution.
idx only exists transiently as the loop counter in autoUnlock.
